environment: iPhone 17 Pro simulator, iOS 26.5, Expo development build, quantity test database
method: Temporary performance.now markers at Pressable onPressIn, grocery onPress, pending-intent publication, AsyncStorage queue/start/end, workspace replay start/end, session publication, React useLayoutEffect commit, and fill onLayout. Samples collected on a localhost-only HTTP listener. Instrumentation and injected faults removed after testing.
limitations: Individual diagnostic samples, not percentile benchmarks or release-device measurements.
Commit and native layout callbacks identify when feedback becomes renderable; these do not measure display scanout or exact first painted pixel.
The 750ms delay and disk failure were injected locally. Offline publication is covered by unit tests; this run does not claim physical-device process-death QA.

samples.scenario: Subscription and row-reference optimization only, editing mode, check
Optimistic feedback with publication handoff, before eager import, first check after restart
samples.observation: Feedback preceded lazy module loading and model publication without reverting. Checked-state actions were subsequently isolated and eagerly imported.

samples.scenario: Injected slow disk failure, shopping mode, uncheck
samples.result: Saved model remained checked; local feedback rolled back after failed persistence.

samples.scenario: Injected 750ms storage delay, successful uncheck in shopping mode
samples.result: Feedback stayed unchecked throughout persistence and model publication; no intermediate revert.
